instruction: Consult the requirements file on the Desktop, perform a strong blur on the Desktop image, and save the blurred image as 'pic.jpg' on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying a blur effect to the image. The evaluator uses multi-step verification with partial credit: 1) File existence check (30%) ensures pic.jpg was created on Desktop, 2) Blur detection (70%) uses Laplacian variance to measure sharpness - lower variance indicates more blur. Original image has variance ~955.58, so max_variance of 200 ensures significant blur was applied. Cannot automatically verify that requirements document was read or that correct source image was used, but the combination of file existence and blur verification provides reasonable confidence that the task was completed.

llm_judge_reasons: Blur detection logic is correct and appropriate: Laplacian variance method with threshold of 200 vs original ~955.58 effectively verifies 'strong blur' requirement
Multi-step partial credit scoring is well-designed: 30% for file existence + 70% for blur effect provides granular verification
File existence check is properly implemented: Getter returns file_exists flag, metric checks it before evaluating blur
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts blur metrics → metric compares against threshold → returns appropriate score
Edge cases handled: Logic handles missing files, invalid images, and computation failures gracefully

Acknowledged limitations documented: Cannot verify 'read requirements document' step (inherent limitation - no checkable output) or verify correct source image was used (would require image comparison logic)
Evaluator successfully verifies all automatically verifiable aspects of the instruction: file creation with correct name and location, strong blur effect applied
fixes_applied: Added explicit file existence check in getter (returns file_exists, variance, is_blurred)
Implemented multi-step evaluator with partial credit: 30% for file existence, 70% for blur effect
Updated metric to check file_exists field before evaluating blur
Note: Cannot automatically verify requirements document reading or source image identity - these are inherent limitations of automated verification
